profile.title: Joash
profile.tagline: I build practical AI/operator tools: CLIs, agent workflows, dashboards, and automation that solve real operational problems.
profile.note: This profile highlights finished or usable work first. Spec-stage and private experiments stay off the front page until they earn the spot.
profile.legend: 🔒 = private repo. Private links only work for authorized users.
profile.thesis: The through-line: build small, useful systems with clear inputs, safe approval gates, tests, and proof artifacts. Less hype, more working software.

repos.name: ops-margin-agent
repos.description: Enterprise tech-spend auditor built with Hermes Agent. Scans cloud, observability, SaaS, and AI inference waste; generates savings reports, remediation artifacts, tickets, Stripe approval cards, and policy-gate outputs. Includes synthetic AcmeCo data and 65 tests.

repos.name: repo-to-shorts-agent
repos.description: Workflow that turns a repository into a launch-ready technical demo video package: analysis, story beats, visual rendering, validation, submission copy, and a Hermes skill wrapper. Includes Remotion/Python rendering paths and a large test suite.

repos.name: agentic-engineering-loop
repos.description: Portable agent skill for shipping software through a controlled loop: brainstorm, plan, implement, review, fix, and compound. Packaged for Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode-style workflows.

repos.name: cardealbot
repos.description: Used-car deal scanner with scheduled scraping, scam detection, aesthetic scoring, market/deal scoring, LLM review, SQLite storage, and Telegram alerts.

repos.name: openclaw-watchdog
repos.description: Self-healing watchdog for OpenClaw/Hermes gateway crashes with graduated recovery and Telegram alerts.

repos.name: gemini-memory-engine
repos.description: Personal semantic-memory experiment using Gemini embeddings for recall across saved inputs.

repos.name: personal-llm-benchmark
repos.description: Personal benchmark suite for comparing LLMs on practical tasks instead of generic vibes.
